fusions.name: Grip and Whirl
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in a blow that deals 15 damage, leaves it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds and makes it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Berserk Cartwheel
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Cartwheels you through a cone 2.5 tiles long that deals 10 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Bough to Bough
fusions.desc: Dashes you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Ratchet Hold
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy puts a stack on it, up to 6. At 6 the stacks all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
